+// A configured whole-repository validator is skipped like a test suite, and the other checks still
+// run and are attributed to the shaped files.
+func TestStaticChecksSkipFullValidator(t *testing.T) {
+	const step = "features/steps/fixture_steps.js"
+	const validator = "python3 reproduce/validate_repo.py"
+	privacy := `if [ -f ` + step + ` ]; then echo "` + step + `:3:5: bad"; fi; exit 1`
+	f := staticFx(t, `    - name: validate-repo
+      run: '`+validator+`'
+    - name: privacy
+      run: '`+privacy+`'
+`)
+	f.write(step, "// BAD\n")
+	cfg, err := project.LoadConfig(f.Root)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	var commands []string
+	real := staticRunCommand
+	staticRunCommand = func(ctx context.Context, s *sys.Session, command, dir string, opts sys.Options) (sys.Result, error) {
+		mu.Lock()
+		commands = append(commands, command)
+		mu.Unlock()
+		return real(ctx, s, command, dir, opts)
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { staticRunCommand = real })
+	s, _, _ := f.session()
+	var progress []string
+	head := f.Repo.Head()
+	tree, err := f.Repo.Tree(head, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	g := newStaticGateRunner(s, f.Repo, &verify.Readiness{Root: f.Root, Repo: f.Repo, Config: cfg}, cfg, f.Root, approveSlug, func(l string) { progress = append(progress, l) })
+	run, err := g.run(context.Background(), head, tree, "package")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, c := range commands {
+		if strings.TrimPrefix(c, "set -x\n") != privacy {
+			t.Errorf("command %q was handed to the command seam, want only the privacy check", c)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(commands) == 0 {
+		t.Error("the privacy check was not run")
+	}
+	status := map[string]string{}
+	for _, c := range run.Checks {
+		status[c.Name] = c.Status
+	}
+	if status["validate-repo"] != staticNotRun || status["privacy"] != staticAttributable || run.Outcome != staticRefused {
+		t.Errorf("statuses %v, outcome %s", status, run.Outcome)
+	}
+	if !slices.Contains(progress, "kogen: static check validate-repo not run: it runs the test suite") {
+		t.Errorf("no not-run progress line in %q", progress)
+	}
+}
